final.background: Trade effluent is liquid waste produced by businesses and factories rather than regular household sewage. A trade-effluent consent is an official permit that allows a company to send this industrial wastewater into public sewers. These permits place strict limits on volume and chemicals to prevent treatment systems from being overwhelmed and to protect local waterways.
